prompts.eli:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-ready six-expression portrait atlas for an existing Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain fan-game archive.
Primary request: create new original fan-made portraits of ELI as he appears in MGSV in 1984, highly faithful to his official Konami character appearance. This is the young adolescent Eli, NOT adult Liquid Snake.
Canvas/layout: exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels; rigid 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal 512 by 512 square cells. Each cell contains one centered head-and-shoulders close-up, same subject identity, same scale, same head position and camera throughout. No gutters, dividers, labels or collage overlaps. Keep complete hair and chin in each cell with a small safety margin.
Subject invariants: young adolescent boy, fine angular youthful face, fair slightly dusty skin, blue-grey eyes, sandy blond hair slicked back from the forehead and reaching the nape with loose ends behind ears, small thin horizontal cheek marks, tight defiant brow, worn dark olive-green open military jacket collar. No adult muscular neck, no facial hair, no eyepatch, no horn, no bandana. Do not age him up or make him an idealized fashion model.
Style: detailed realistic cinematic game portrait, textured natural skin, faithful in-game design, matching a realistic Codec portrait collection. Chest-up clothed framing. Dark near-black forest-green uniform background, subdued green rim light and soft natural key light. No dramatic environment or props.
Expressions in exact row-major order: top-left neutral guarded stare; top-middle serious narrowed eyes; top-right warning tense alarm with slightly parted lips; bottom-left calm softened gaze; bottom-middle humor very slight knowing lopsided smirk, not a broad grin; bottom-right glitch same neutral identity with subtle horizontal green digital signal breaks, keep face readable.
Constraints: all six must clearly be the exact SAME child character at the exact same age. Portrait variations only, not costume or hair changes. Original rendering based on inspected official character reference, not a traced official screenshot. No text, no logos, no watermark, no weapons, no gore, no duplicate cell artwork.
prompts.tretij:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-ready six-state portrait atlas for an existing Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain fan-game archive.
Primary request: create new original fan-made portraits of Tretij Rebenok, the young masked red-haired boy in MGSV, as faithful as possible to the inspected official Konami Play Arts Kai figure. Do NOT substitute adult bald Psycho Mantis.
Canvas/layout: exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels; rigid 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal 512 by 512 square cells. Each cell contains one centered head-and-shoulders close-up, identical subject identity, head scale, framing, costume and background. No gutters, dividers, labels or overlapping cells. Entire head and lower mask visible in every cell.
Subject invariants: slender small adolescent, thick tousled auburn-red layered hair swept apart around the forehead and outward at the sides, crown slightly spiky. Full black rubber gas mask covers ALL face, opaque dark eye lenses, angular upper mask and long nose section, prominent forward projecting cylindrical lower respirator with grey-metal rim, broad dark straps. Black high-collared straightjacket-like restraint garment, glossy worn fabric/leather folds, buckled horizontal straps across chest and shoulders. No bare mouth, no exposed teeth, no skin facial expressions, no unmasked face, no bald head, no military helmet.
Style: detailed realistic cinematic Codec archive portrait, sharp readable mask silhouette and material detail, restrained game-realistic proportions. Near-black forest-green uniform background, subtle green rim light and soft keylight.
Six states in exact row-major order, conveyed ONLY by slight head/shoulder angle and lighting while mask/costume remains invariant: top-left neutral forward gaze; top-middle serious head slightly lowered; top-right warning very small alert head lift and tense shoulders; bottom-left calm relaxed lowered shoulders; bottom-middle humor slight inquisitive head tilt, NOT cartoon grin; bottom-right glitch neutral pose with subtle horizontal green digital signal breaks while mask stays readable. Distinct but subtle poses.
Constraints: original fan-made rendering informed by the reference, not tracing the product photo. Keep the full mask on in ALL cells. No text, labels, logos, watermark, weapons, flames or gore. Do not invent smile holes or expressions on rubber mask.
prompts.ishmael:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-ready six-expression portrait atlas for an existing Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain fan-game archive.
Primary request: create new original fan-made portraits of ISHMAEL from the MGSV hospital prologue, faithful to the inspected in-game model and original concept reproduced on Creative Uncut.
Canvas/layout: exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels; rigid 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal 512 by 512 square cells. One centered head-and-shoulders close-up in each cell with identical identity, scale, framing, clothing and background. No gutters or panel dividers. Keep full bandaged scalp and chin in each cell.
Subject invariants: adult male hospital patient, ENTIRE scalp, cheeks, nose bridge, chin and jaw wrapped in layered slightly grubby off-white/grey gauze bandages. Narrow horizontal opening for the eyes, narrow separate opening for lips; nose mostly wrapped. Follow plausible overlapping bandage strips, constant wrap pattern across all six states. He wears a plain muted teal-green hospital gown with broad round neckline; shoulders visible, no white uniform. No exposed beard, no visible hair, no eyepatch, no horn, no helmet, no unmasked alternate face, no open injuries or gore.
Style: detailed realistic cinematic game portrait, faithful MGSV game design, tactile gauze cloth and hospital fabric, matching a realistic Codec archive portrait collection. Dark near-black forest-green uniform background, soft natural keylight and subdued green rim lighting.
Expressions row-major: top-left neutral attentive eyes; top-middle serious narrowed eye slit; top-right warning alert eyes and slightly parted lips through the opening; bottom-left calm softened gaze; bottom-middle humor tiny eye crinkle and restrained lip-corner change through the slit, not broad smile; bottom-right glitch same neutral head with subtle horizontal green digital transmission artifacts and fully readable bandages.
Constraints: expression changes only within visible openings, no facial anatomy or bandage rearrangements, no dramatic head angle changes. Original fan-made asset, not copied official key art. No text, labels, logos, watermark, weapons, blood, gore or extra people. Each cell subtly distinct and usable as an individual portrait.
